cases.name: Wendy Duan
cases.about: She was a language arts teacher at Boone Elementary School in the Alief Independent School District. Wendys' Twitter account was largely dedicated to photos praising her students and fellow teachers, with many expressions of her enthusiasm for her job.
cases.narrative: She was found shot to death in her backyard.
